project_type: TypeScript AWS CDK application with Lambda functions, Step Functions orchestration, and container image Lambdas
build_system: pnpm monorepo with AWS CDK for IaC. Node.js 22 runtime. Container images for Marp Lambda.
test_framework: vitest for unit tests, CDK assertions for IaC tests, contract tests for renderer port implementations
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm install 2. pnpm build (TypeScript compilation) 3. pnpm test (unit + contract tests) 4. pnpm lint (type checking + formatting)
snapshot_or_generated_files: CDK snapshot tests in **/*.snapshot.json - regenerate with pnpm test -- -u
setup_instructions: Node.js 22 (available via nvm), pnpm available globally. Run pnpm install at workspace root.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode - npm registry accessible. No Docker daemon available for building container images in CI. Use AST validation and CDK assertions instead of deployed integration tests.
contribution_requirements: Follow design document (slide-first-ai-video-design.md) as single source of truth. productSlug configurable via CDK context. TypeScript with AWS SDK v3. Bedrock Converse API for all model calls. VideoRenderer port with two implementations.
key_patterns: VideoRenderer port interface (plan/renderChunk/assemble). Parallel Marp PNG + Polly audio execution. PCM audio with measured duration. Speech marks to captions/VTT/SRT conversion. S3 key-based data passing between Step Functions states. Idempotency-Key on mutation APIs. Content-addressed caching.
directory_structure: Planned structure: packages/ (shared types, core logic), infra/ (CDK stacks), lambdas/ (Lambda handlers), config/ (environment configs)
